verdict.rationale: Bases is a first-party core plugin that creates database-like views of notes. Its docs say you can view, edit, sort and filter files by their properties, and it includes a Kanban view that groups cards into columns by a property. Independent users corroborate it: one calls it about a 90% replacement for Dataview that is much faster, and another used it for property-based overviews of campaign NPCs. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of table and list view types, evidence of query/filter expression depth (the community notes it is less comprehensive than Dataview), and explicit confirmation that views update live.
